caption: The video opens on a black screen displaying a red-and-white safety warning about parkour and Team STORROR, then cuts to a fisheye-lens view through a grimy window overlooking a coastal prison complex under an overcast sky. A white italic 'STORROR' logo animates over the footage before a hand in a grey sleeve grips the window frame and the camera turns inward. Audio is sparse: low wind rumble, a sharp two-tone whistle around 00:04, and a metallic clank.
visual: Verbatim on-screen text on black: 'WARNING / PARKOUR AND ASSOCIATED ACTIVITIES ARE INHERENTLY DANGEROUS AND CAN CAUSE SERIOUS INJURY AND / OR DEATH. / ALL MEMBERS OF TEAM STORROR HAVE BEEN TRAINING FOR OVER 15 YEARS. / THE STUNTS IN THESE VIDEOS ARE PERFORMED BY PROFESSIONALS OR UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF PROFESSIONALS. / DO NOT COPY.' Then: dark window frame edges, beige brick institutional buildings with arched windows and green doors, a paved road, patchy grass, distant green hills and grey sea; heavy fisheye barrel distortion; centered white stylized 'STORROR' wordmark that fades.
audio: Near-silence with low ambient wind rumble at the warning card; a piercing two-tone whistle (guard-style) sounds ~00:04-00:06; a dull metallic clank follows as the camera moves; no music.

caption: Inside a dilapidated prison cell, a young man with short blond hair in a light-grey tracksuit and grey sneakers sits hunched on the edge of a bed covered with a black tarp; the POV camera-wearer's grey-sleeved arm enters frame. The man rises, walks to the red door at the back, and pushes it open onto a brightly lit corridor, initiating the escape.
visual: Cell interior: peeling cream/yellow walls with stains, brown floor, white wall-mounted sink on left, red wooden door with small window at rear, black sheet/tarp over bedding on right, white electrical box on wall. The seated prisoner stands, crosses the room, and opens the red door revealing a pale green/white hallway beyond.
audio: Soft shuffling footsteps on the hard floor, fabric rustle, then the creak/clack of the door latch and door swinging open; ambient room tone; no music.

caption: The chase begins: two runners in matching light-grey tracksuits sprint along an upper-level walkway of a multi-storey prison atrium with teal-green railings and white mesh cages. A guard in a white short-sleeved shirt, black tie and black trousers pursues from behind, shouting. The runners vault the railing, scramble over a curved wire-mesh cage, and drop into a stairwell as the guard follows.
visual: Bright institutional atrium: white walls, pale green doors, green-painted railings, wire-mesh enclosures, multiple levels visible with skylights above. Runners leap the railing, hang and climb the mesh, then descend metal-grate stairs; the guard appears mid-corridor running toward camera.
audio: Loud pounding footsteps, heavy breathing, metallic rattling of railings and mesh, and the guard's shouted commands ('Stop!' / 'Get back here!') echoing in the atrium; no music.
speech: Guard shouts pursuit commands such as 'Stop!' and 'Get back here!'; runners vocalize exertion grunts.

caption: On the stairwell the guard lunges and grapples with a runner but ends up tumbling to the ground; the runners scramble up another mesh fence and launch across the atrium void, catching the opposite railing and swinging themselves over while the guard rises and resumes the chase below.
visual: Close-quarters scuffle on green-floored stairs; guard in white shirt/black trousers sprawled on the floor; POV hands grip white mesh and green top rail; a wide leap across the open atrium with the multi-level cell blocks and skylit roof visible; swinging body-carry over the railing.
audio: Scuffling, a heavy thud as the guard falls, clangs of metal railing, whoosh of the jump, continued shouting from the guard and breathless exertion sounds; no music.
speech: Guard continues shouting after the runners; indistinct pursuit yells.

caption: The POV runner balances on a railing high above the atrium floor where the guard reaches up, then drops down to a lower walkway, lands, and sprints on; the group bounds up another flight of metal stairs, putting vertical distance between themselves and the pursuing guard.
visual: Downward view of grey sneaker on green railing, guard below with arms raised; landing on a teal-floored walkway; rapid ascent of dark metal-grate stairs with green handrails; other grey-clad runners ahead.
audio: Footstep impacts on metal grating, railing clangs, heavy breathing, distant echoing shouts; no music.
speech: Faint shouted exchanges between guard and runners; no clear dialogue.

caption: The runners charge down a corridor lined with pale-green doors, burst through a doorway into a dim shaft, and climb a red metal ladder up through a square hatch onto the sunlit roof. Blue sky with cumulus clouds replaces the gloom; the prison yard with a green sports field and perimeter fences spreads below as one runner edges along the roof.
visual: Corridor with repeating mint-green doors and barred windows; red-painted steel ladder/rail in a beige brick shaft; hatch opening to bright exterior; rooftop with grey concrete, brick parapets, chain-link-topped fences, distant sea and hills; runner in grey tracksuit balancing on roof edge.
audio: Sprint footsteps, hatch/ladder metallic clanks, then a swell of outdoor wind as they emerge; breathing continues; no music.

caption: The group slides and rolls down a long sloped corrugated-metal roof studded with skylight strips, the POV hands skimming the surface; they reach the lower section, run along the ridge, and hop a small gap, the camera-wearer's shadow stretching across the panels.
visual: Grey ribbed metal roofing with rectangular glass skylights; runners in light-grey tracksuits sliding feet-first then scrambling upright; bright sun, blue sky with scattered clouds; prison buildings and green fields in background; elongated shadow of the camera operator on the roof.
audio: Continuous scraping/sliding of clothing and shoes on metal, wind buffeting the mic, footfalls, breathing; no music.

caption: At the roof's edge the runners leap down onto a concrete ledge and then a grassy embankment, roll to absorb the impact, and sprint across a paved yard between beige brick buildings toward a low brick structure, beginning the next climb.
visual: Drop from roof to grey concrete slab, then green grass slope with a roll; wide paved courtyard with cracks and weeds, multi-storey tan brick prison blocks, blue sky; runners approach a single-storey brick building with white-framed windows.
audio: Heavy landing thuds, rustle of grass, rapid footsteps on pavement, breathing; no music.

caption: Climbers scale a vertical drainpipe on the brick wall to pull themselves onto a flat roof; the group then sprints across the rooftop and leaps a gap between buildings, landing and continuing without pause, with the sea horizon visible beyond the compound.
visual: Tan brick wall with grey metal downpipe and black cable; hands and feet on pipe; flat grey roof surfaces, ventilation boxes, chain-link fence tops; a running leap across a void to an adjacent roof; distant blue sea and coastline.
audio: Metallic rattle of the pipe, grunts of effort, footfalls on roof, a shouted encouragement ('Go, go, go!'), wind; no music.
speech: Runners call out urgency cues like 'Go, boys, go!' while climbing and jumping.

caption: The runners drop down successive lower roof sections, slide and climb between levels, then traverse a narrow concrete ledge between two buildings before leaping into a paved alley, keeping momentum toward the perimeter.
visual: Stepped roof descent with grey surfaces and brick walls; balance run along a thin ledge above a gap; drop to a narrow asphalt passage between cream and brick walls with weeds at the edges.
audio: Impacts of landings, scraping on concrete, quick footsteps, breathing; no music.

caption: Exiting through a metal gate into the outer yard, the runners are met by several guards in white shirts and black trousers, one mounted on a green ATV; the group veers away, sprinting along a fenced path and diving into a covered mesh walkway as the guards give chase on foot and by vehicle.
visual: Open gate onto gravel/asphalt yard; 3-4 guards converging, one on a green quad bike; tall chain-link fences with barbed wire; runners in grey tracksuits racing down a straight fenced corridor and entering a roofed wire-mesh passage.
audio: ATV engine revving, guards shouting, pounding footsteps, mesh rattling; no music.
speech: Guards shout pursuit orders; runners yell 'Go, go, go!' to each other.

caption: The runners vault a cream perimeter wall onto a dark flat roof, sprint across it, and leap down to the ground beside a parked white minibus, continuing their escape route through the compound's outer buildings.
visual: Tall pale wall with green trim; dark grey roof with vents; drop to asphalt next to a white Mercedes-style minibus; barbed-wire fencing and low industrial buildings around.
audio: Wall-climb scrapes, footfalls on roof, landing thud, breathing; no music.

caption: Passing the bus and the green ATV, the runners are pursued on foot and by vehicle; they scramble up a grassy embankment and plunge into a ditch thick with weeds and purple wildflowers, momentarily breaking the guards' line of sight.
visual: White minibus and green quad bike on paved area; guards running; steep green slope with dry grass; runners sliding into a overgrown ditch with tall weeds and purple flower spikes; sea and buildings beyond the ridge.
audio: ATV engine, shouted commands, rustling vegetation, thuds of the slide, heavy breathing; no music.
speech: Guards shout; runners urge each other onward.

caption: Using a black pipe/cable for handholds, the runners climb the steep bank and then traverse horizontally along the pipe fixed to a tall brick wall, working their way up to an elevated walkway with metal railings.
visual: Close-up of hands on weathered black pipe against beige brick; a runner in grey tracksuit shimmying along the pipe with feet braced on the wall; grassy slope and concrete structures below; metal railing of an upper platform coming into view.
audio: Grunts of effort, scraping of shoes on brick, wind, a voiced 'Come on' encouragement; no music.
speech: Runners exchange short encouragements ('Come on,' 'Easy does it') during the climb.

caption: The group vaults the railing onto the walkway, sprints through a vaulted brick tunnel whose arches echo their footsteps, emerges onto a railed bridge over a grassy slope, and drops down to a public road, leaving the prison complex behind.
visual: Grey metal railing climb-over; long arched brick corridor with fluorescent lights; bridge with railings over green embankment and trees; descent to an asphalt road with street lamps and houses.
audio: Clang of railing, echoing footfalls inside the tunnel, breathing, wind returning outdoors; no music.
speech: Urgent calls of 'Come on, come on' and 'Keep going' among the runners.

caption: Three runners in light-grey tracksuits sprint away down the road with the blue sea and white houses behind them; the white 'STORROR' logo flashes over the footage and end-card overlays appear promoting subscriptions, more videos, and clothing, as the chase audio fades to footsteps, breathing and wind.
visual: Sunlit asphalt road curving past grassy banks, trees, houses and the sea horizon; three grey-clad runners receding; on-screen text: pink 'SUBSCRIBE FOR VIDEOS EVERY MONDAY', white 'WATCH MORE', pink 'CLOTHING AVAILABLE AT STORROR.COM', plus thumbnail images and a brief centered 'STORROR' wordmark.
audio: Fading footfalls, heavy breathing, open-air wind; no music or dialogue at the close.
